newsitem.title: USA: Breuners Home Furnishings names Reddington CEO.
newsitem.headline: Breuners Home Furnishings names Reddington CEO.

text.p: G. Joseph Reddington, chief executive officer of Signature Group, has been named chief executive officer and a director of Breuners Home Furnishings Corp, Breuners said.
Signature is jointly owned by Montgomery Ward & Co and General Electric Co's General Electric Capital Corp affiliate.

Reddington takes over CEO duties from Michael H. Solomon and reports to Breuners' board of directors. Solomon remains Breuners' chairman of the board. Fred Berk, Breuners' president, will report to Reddington.
Reddington joined Signature Group as CEO in 1994 after spending twenty-eight years with Sears, Roebuck and Co Inc.
